title: Channel
summary: One channel: state, endpoints, traffic, errors, alerts and the live transcript.

sections.title: What you see
paragraphs: The state, the session, the stop reason, the configuration version the instance started from, and a countdown while a retry waits.

A bridge shows side A and side B (endpoint, state, peer, failure streak, last activity, bytes), bytes each way, framed message counts when a tap is set, and each buffer with its limit and overflow count.

A message channel shows its source (endpoint state, protocol, session, last received, counters) and one card per destination: queued, sending and unresolved deliveries, oldest queued age, next attempt, last acknowledgement and last error. Deliveries that failed in their mapping were never sent: fix the mapping, then resend. Links open Messages for the channel or its unresolved deliveries; Recent messages lists the last 10.
The last error shows what happens next, for the part that failed: a destination's error shows that destination's streak and next attempt, apart from the health of the source session.

sections.title: Actions
paragraphs: Pause keeps accepted messages queued and asks first. Resume starts from the active configuration. Restart closes the session, resets this instance's counters and asks first. A button is missing when the engine does not allow it now.

sections.title: Live transcript
paragraphs: Off until you start it, and shown only to you. See Live transcript help.
